outcome.technical: Root cause: the hostile-content override rule added by attempt 1 (`:where(table.phases,table.data) :is(.chip,.rchip,.bandpill,.dl,.heldby,.tevn,.tevf,.ptev){white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}` in tables.css) has the same specificity (0,1,0) as the atoms' own component rules declared elsewhere (e.g. `.bandpill{...;white-space:nowrap}` in usage.css), because :where() strips the table ancestor's specificity to zero. tables.css loads before usage.css in _ui_theme.py's REPORT_CSS_PARTS, so on an equal-specificity tie the LATER-loaded file wins in a real engine: `.bandpill`'s own `nowrap` beat the override. Isolated the exact element with a temporary debug pass inside tools/check-report-interactive.mjs (reverted before filing, not part of this diff): at viewport 833px, `SPAN.bandpill.b-outlier` computed `white-space:nowrap`, width 1120px, with document.documentElement.scrollWidth 1489 vs clientWidth 833 - the only atom of the eight still refusing to wrap. Fix: dropped the :where() around the table ancestor (kept :is() for the atom-class list), so the selector reads `table.phases :is(...), table.data :is(...)`. Specificity becomes (0,2,1), which outranks every plain `.chip`/`.bandpill`/etc. base rule (0,1,0) regardless of file load order - the override wins by construction, not by which stylesheet happens to load later. Verification: a scratch render (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=examples/acme-store python3 plugins/audit/scripts/report/render-report.py examples/acme-store/audit-plan.json --out-dir /tmp/p125-26-scratch --basename acme-store-audit, then node tools/check-report-interactive.mjs /tmp/p125-26-scratch/acme-store-audit.html) passes all 186 checks, including the new hostile-content case ('an unbroken run with no space or hyphen, planted into every status/value atom ... widens nothing ...: got none, want none'). Updated the pre-existing literal CSS pin u14ktw in plugins/audit/tests/test_render_report.py to the corrected selector text (it still pinned the old, losing :where() form); python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_render_report.py --selftest now passes 298/298 (was 297/298 before the pin update).
